docs.text: HPE OpenStack Cinder Drivers Welcome to the documentation for HPE OpenStack Block Storage (Cinder) drivers . This site covers: - Alletra MP / Primera / 3PAR drivers - Nimble / Alletra 6k drivers - RHOSP deployment guides (17 and 18) - Best Practices for HPE storage in OpenStack These drivers allow seamless integration of HPE storage systems with OpenStack Block Storage.

docs.text: Best Practices Guide The HPE Best Practices Guide (BPG) outlines recommended configurations. Highlights Enable multipathing for iSCSI and FC. Use thin provisioning by default. Separate CPGs for different workloads. Apply QoS for performance-sensitive applications. Use Peer Persistence for high availability. 📄 Full document: HPE BPG PDF

docs.text: Extra Specs & QoS HPE drivers support extra-specs to control volume characteristics. Common Extra-Specs hpe3par:cpg=<cpg-name> hpe3par:flash_cache=true|false hpe3par:compression=true|false hpe3par:qos=<qos-id> QoS Define QoS rules in the array. Map volume types to QoS profiles via extra-specs.

docs.text: FC / iSCSI Configuration Fibre Channel Ensure proper zoning between hosts and array ports. Mask volumes using WWNs. iSCSI Configure multipathd. Ensure initiators are registered on the array. Example config snippet in /etc/multipath.conf : ini defaults { user_friendly_names yes find_multipaths yes } Notes Use CHAP for authentication in iSCSI. Multipathing ensures resiliency.

docs.text: Installation & Enabling the Driver Install required packages: bash pip install python-3parclient Edit cinder.conf : ```ini [DEFAULT] enabled_backends = hpe3par [hpe3par] volume_driver = cinder.volume.drivers.hpe.hpe_3par_fc.HPE3PARFCDriver san_ip = san_login = san_password = hpe3par_api_url = https:// :8080/api/v1 hpe3par_cpg = ``` Restart Cinder services: bash systemctl restart openstack-cinder-volume

docs.text: Overview The HPE Cinder drivers provide integration between OpenStack Block Storage (Cinder) and the following storage families: HPE Alletra MP HPE Primera HPE 3PAR StoreServ Supported protocols: - iSCSI - Fibre Channel (FC) The driver is based on the HPE 3PAR Web Services API (WSAPI) and python-3parclient.

docs.text: System Requirements Software Requirements HPE 3PAR OS v3.1.3 MU1 or later. Deduplication: requires SSDs and OS v3.2.1 MU1+. Flash Cache Policy: OS v3.2.1 MU2+, Flash Cache enabled, python-3parclient ≥ 4.2.0. Compression: requires SSDs and OS v3.3.1 MU1+ (8k/20k series). Primera / Alletra MP: python-3parclient ≥ 4.2.14. Network Requirements iSCSI: multipathing strongly recommended. FC: zoning between initiators and storage ports. WSAPI server must be enabled. Storage Requirements At least one Common Provisioning Group (CPG). Licenses for Peer Persistence and replication (if used).
docs.title: System Requirements

docs.text: NSP for FC Bootable Volumes The driver can use Node/Slot/Port (NSP) values to bind FC bootable volumes to specific host ports. This allows administrators to control host-path associations.

docs.text: Peer Persistence HPE Peer Persistence provides: - Transparent failover between two arrays - Zero RPO (synchronous replication) - Continuous availability during site failures Enable replication and configure Peer Persistence in Cinder by setting: replication_device = backend_id:remote_array, san_ip:<ip>, san_login:<user>, san_password:<pass>

docs.text: Consistency Group Replication The Nimble driver supports replication for consistency groups. Volumes can be replicated synchronously or asynchronously. Requires replication partnership between arrays. Configure in Cinder with: ini replication_device = backend_id:remote_nimble, san_ip:<ip>, san_login:<user>, san_password:<pass>
